title: Solomon Asks for Wisdom
summary: Wisdom is better than showing off because it helps us honor God and serve people. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read 1 Kings 3:5-14 and look for how this passage teaches: Wisdom is better than showing off because it helps us honor God and serve people.

tell_it: God asked Solomon what he wanted. Solomon asked for wisdom to lead God's people well.
understand_it: Wisdom is better than showing off because it helps us honor God and serve people. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Solomon Asks for Wisdom reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Wisdom matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Solomon Asks for Wisdom shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Wisdom is better than showing off because it helps us honor God and serve people.
teen_explanation: Solomon Asks for Wisdom gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that wisdom is better than showing off because it helps us honor God and serve people. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Wisdom is better than showing off because it helps us honor God and serve people.
God's people can bring real needs and feelings to Him.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when wisdom is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What did Solomon ask God for?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Wisdom. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that wisdom is better than showing off because it helps us honor God and serve people.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember 1 Kings 3:9 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Solomon Asks for Wisdom?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Wisdom Wish
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Wisdom is better than showing off because it helps us honor God and serve people.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Solomon Asks for Wisdom. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
